attributes.action: Review Section 104 pornography offences and their impact on adult expression
attributes.additional_details: Section 104 may have unintended consequences for consensual adult BDSM performances, including facesitting where no breathing restriction occurs. Although guidance exists, uncertainty remains about staged depictions and what creators may lawfully retain or publish. We ask for a proportionate review that considers safeguarding, freedom of expression, age-restricted platforms and the impact on independent creators, with meaningful consultation of affected professionals.
attributes.background: Review Section 104 of the Crime & Policing Act 2026, consider amendments to protect consensual adult expression and ensure proportionality, and publish clearer guidance on how the offences apply to BDSM depictions, particularly facesitting, including material distributed on age-restricted platforms

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Repeal and replace the 2026 ban on depictions of suffocation in pornography" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785760
